Great place to try an upscale twist of traditional Vietnamese food
Dec 2022 • Family
Ambience is simple but pleasing; piped in music while we were at the restaurant distracted from the decor. The staff appears to understand basic English but menu is in English so it overcomes their lack of language skill. The menu is full of interesting Vietnamese food choices - all very basic but done with a culinary touch. The pho broth was very good and the noodles really nice. They had a tensile strength not normally found in fresh noodles. The crispy noodle with beef and vegetables was truly outstanding. The mixture of vegetables was perfect and the beef was excellent. The crispy noodles were really well presented and crunchy and flaky. A real pleasant surprise. Well worth a second or third visit to try their other dishes

American sized portions of viet food
Jun 2019 • Friends
As someone born and raised in the US, this restaurants gives me a slice of home. The owners are Vietnamese Americans and it is reflected in the quality of ingredients and portion sizes. I have tried the pho here and the mi xao gion, along with all of their rolls, and I recommend all of it. Be prepared to take home food. The prices are also comparable to typical Vietnamese restaurants but with double the portion size. Great value for the money.

Restaurant is also super clean and service is fantastic. I think the restaurant mostly serves customers who live in the nearby Vinhomes; this place would be much more popular if it was on a major street and neighborhood.
